scenario: asking for help with taxi & ride services
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Taxi and Ride Services
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: taxi & ride services — asking for help with taxi & ride services
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with taxi & ride services; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Daniel to help her carry a box to the car.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ anh Daniel giúp mang một thùng đồ ra xe.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Daniel, can you help me carry this box to the car?
turns.vietnamese: Daniel này, anh giúp tôi mang thùng đồ này ra xe được không?

turns.speaker: Mr Daniel
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, để tôi mang cho.
